prompt: Create an edge-to-edge 1440×1000 desktop web homepage comp for Glewstudio, a learning library where people discover studio and commercial photography courses. Use the existing featured course “Iluminación Cinematográfica: Del Concepto al Resultado” and description “Aprende a diseñar esquemas de iluminación complejos para retratos, moda y fotografía comercial con Carlos Mendoza.” Include glass actions “Reproducir”, “Más información”, and “Mi Lista” with a plus icon. Use real course title examples in horizontal rails: “Iluminación Rembrandt para Retrato”, “Retoque de Piel en Photoshop CC”, “Fotografía de Producto en Mesa de Luz”, “Color Grading Cinematográfico”, and “Softboxes, Paraguas y Modificadores”. Add a compact, horizontal category selector for Iluminación, Edición, Producto, and Detrás de Cámaras. Membership information sits further down the page. Do not invent ratings, student counts, testimonials, or performance claims. Preserve the existing Glewstudio mark/name, Manrope, OLED background #0A0A0F, warm-gold #E8B86D accent, and restrained polished character. Composition variation: make this a browse-first home, not a feature-first billboard. Keep the hero cinematic but compact in the top portion, with its image and text sharing a wide banner, then let the category selector and first two course rails occupy most of the opening viewport. Show several card thumbnails and subtle side-arrow controls, with a clear sequence from featured course to fast discovery. Crisp readable Spanish UI labels; complete top navigation, no browser frame or device. It must read as an interactive streaming product screen, not an ad, poster, or portfolio board. No Netflix or Max logos or proprietary artwork.
